scope: Independent file-only integrity/alignment check of the reserved V9 directory; existing source semantic approvals verified by exact source-part/review bindings. This receipt does not activate data, grant training, rerun Core, or independently re-adjudicate the authored semantics.

method.literal_mask_check: Independently reconstructed all paired unescaped ASCII quote spans, SHA256-based ordered FHX identifiers, input-derived target replacement/restoration, and complete ScribeKeyFast prompts; confirmed no Core dictionary markers or pre-existing FHX identifiers in these pairs. No training/evaluation helper was imported.
method.full_original_fields: Every raw row equals its source-part row; concatenated part lines exactly equal raw dataset lines. Normalized rows preserve every original parsed field and add only split=train and the independently checked core_normalization metadata.
method.text_comparison: Exact Unicode string equality and UTF-8 SHA256, with no normalization applied to zero-delta comparisons. The separate saved opaque-content hash index was recomputed with its declared NFC/whitespace/casefold transform.
method.saved_binaries: Only byte hashes/sizes of in-directory frozen probe files checked; no binary executed.
